<body>

  <header>
    <h1>Smart Enterprise</h1>
    <p>Empowering Communities Through Social Innovation</p>
  </header>

  <div class="container">

    <div class="section">
      <h2>About Smart Enterprise</h2>
      <p>
        Smart Enterprise is a diverse, community-based organization driven by a team of compassionate professionals dedicated to promoting equity, empowerment, and holistic development. We work to improve the quality of life in underserved communities through education, outreach, and culturally responsive human services.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="section">
      <h2>Introducing the 360 Program</h2>
      <p>
        The <strong>360 Program</strong> is Smart Enterprise’s flagship initiative, designed specifically to support African American communities facing systemic barriers. The program takes a 360-degree approach to community wellness and development by addressing root causes of social and economic challenges.
      </p>

      <h3>Program Focus Areas:</h3>
      <ul>
        <li>Reducing fear of death through grief support, legacy planning, and spiritual counseling</li>
        <li>Combating drug addiction with evidence-based recovery services and peer support</li>
        <li>Preventing crime and violence while supporting victims and returning citizens</li>
        <li>Addressing mental illness with community-centered mental health resources</li>
        <li>Reducing recidivism through mentorship, skill-building, and re-entry programs</li>
        <li>Fighting unemployment through job readiness, training, and placement support</li>
        <li>Combating poverty with access to housing, food, and financial literacy programs</li>
        <li>Providing stability to those facing temporary or unstable housing situations</li>
      </ul>
    </div>

    <div class="section">
      <h2>Why Diversity Matters</h2>
      <p>
        Our staff represents the communities we serve. By building a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds and lived experiences, we are better equipped to understand, relate to, and respond to our community’s needs. Our diversity is not just a value—it’s a strategy for change.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="section">
      <h2>A Personal Mission</h2>
      <p>
        The 360 Program is also deeply personal—designed with the intent of improving the quality of life not only for all members of the community but especially for our founder’s daughter and future generations. We believe that by building up the community, we protect and elevate our children.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="section">
      <h2>Contact Us</h2>
      <p>Email: info@smartenterprise.org<br/>
      Phone: (555) 123-4567<br/>
      Address: 123 Smart Way, Community City, ST 00000</p>
    </div>

  </div>
